courses.title: Healing Darkness
courses.description: A recorded rest practice that lets the eyes settle like the setting sun and welcomes the quiet of natural darkness into the whole body. A downloadable track from Jennifer's Sacred Sleep Yoga shop.

courses.title: Melatonin Magic
courses.description: A bedtime visualisation with the night sky and the North Star, to be practised in low light before or in bed as a way into deep rest. A downloadable recording.

courses.title: Bone Deep Sleep
courses.description: A short yoga nidra for sleep that moves breath awareness through the eyes, heart, belly and bones, setting aside outside demands. A downloadable recording.

flags: These three were noted as free in the batch, but they are $10.00 recordings in her shop, so they go in as offerings (downloads). Price shown as '$10.00' with no code on the pages (the original plan wrote USD).
Melatonin Magic says it helps 'nourish your own natural melatonin production'; a body-function line, no condition named, kept. Its description here leaves that out.
